notes.title: Demo now deactivated as NextFest is over
notes.content: [p]Next Fest has ended, and with it, the access to the free demo of Temptation at Sunset Cove. We had several thousand downloads of the demo during Next Fest, and based on the jump in the number of wishlists were seeing, people liked what they saw, which is awesome![/p][p][/p][p]We are still on target for a Q3 release of the full game, so stay tuned for more updates as we get closer to full release.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Launches tonight
notes.content:
As part of the preparation for Steam Next Fest, a press review of participating games will be going on over the next week or so. To facilitate that, we are releasing the Temptation at Sunset Cove Demo tonight at 8pm PST and making it available to everyone. Note though that the demo will most likely only be available during Next Fest, so act now if you want a sneak peak.

The demo will give you a taste of the first few scenes/chapters of the game, and depending on choices made, you will see somewhere between 0 and 6 sensual encounter movies, as well as dozens of still image renders. It wont include any (major) story spoilers though, so be sure to come back for the full game to see how the full story unfolds.

notes.title: The store page is live!
notes.content: It has been a long journey to get here, but we are officially on our way to our planned Q3 release of Temptation at Sunset Cove. Based on the amount of wishlists we are seeing already, it appears there is considerable excitement in the community for our launch as well. Stay tuned for further updates as we get closer to release.
